# Skip Skills<AvailableFrom v="4.0.503" />

Do not update installed Remotion Agent Skills while upgrading Remotion.

## CLI flag

```text
--skip-skills
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion upgrade`](/docs/cli/upgrade)

- [All options](/docs/options)
